description: Match a lockfile against an advisory feed and return the affected dependencies ranked by severity. When you have a lockfile and an advisory list and want the overlap ranked. Do not choose this when you need live advisory data or transitive resolution (use a scanner). Example requests: Which of my dependencies have known vulnerabilities? | Triage this lockfile against the advisory feed and rank the risk. | Are any of these pinned packages affected by a CVE?

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

advisories.description: The customer's advisories.json, as text. Supported: JSON array, or one 'package,version,severity' per line. The advisory feed. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

lockfile.description: The customer's lockfile.json, as text. Supported: JSON lockfile, or a requirements-style list. The dependency lockfile. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_dependency_vulnerability_triage

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Dependency vulnerability triage
